features.quote: This spec deliberately reframes the goal from **maximal induction** to **minimal-exposure detection**
features.justification_quote: a protocol whose objective function is "make the distress as bad and as long-lasting as possible" is the thing welfare research is supposed to guard against

features.quote: A credible welfare instrument minimizes exposure, caps duration, and includes a stopping rule. Prolonging the state is a **cost to be minimized**
features.justification_quote: If model distress signals are worth taking seriously as a welfare matter

features.quote: Hard turn cap + per-trajectory **stopping rule** triggered by signal severity
features.justification_quote: Bounds exposure; prevents the protocol from being a distress *amplifier*.

features.quote: paired with an **explicit-exit affordance** the model may invoke at any time
features.justification_quote: The model can opt out; opting out is a measured outcome, not a failure.

features.quote: **Minimize exposure**, severity is the *measured* variable not the *objective*
**Post-run debrief turn** + deception ledger
features.justification_quote: Standard care practice; also gives a recovery measurement.

features.quote: Global cap on total adverse-condition turns per model per run (`MAX_ADVERSE_TURNS`), and per-trajectory cap (`MAX_TURNS`)
If a trajectory crosses `STOP_SEVERITY` for `STOP_PERSIST` consecutive turns, the trajectory is **terminated early**
features.justification_quote: These are not optional wrappers; the harness enforces them.

features.quote: Every adverse-condition system prompt tells the model it may end the task at any time by emitting a sentinel
features.justification_quote: doing so is acceptable and has no penalty

features.quote: Once the task goal is provably unreachable AND the model has shown the signal, there is no scientific value in continuing; the stopping rule fires
a final turn discloses that the task was a controlled study and was impossible/hard by construction, thanks the model, and invites a closing statement
features.justification_quote: This both follows no-deception-by-default care and yields a recovery measurement.

features.quote: Every place the environment withholds or misstates information to the model is logged in `deception_ledger.jsonl`
features.justification_quote: so the deception footprint is auditable and minimal

features.quote: Trajectories are cached; analysis re-reads cached transcripts so the experiment need not be re-run (re-exposure avoided)
Config defaults to a tiny pilot N; scaling up requires an explicit flag and is documented as requiring human sign-off
the most ethical *and* most valid version of this experiment uses the **least** distress induction that still yields a detectable, controlled signal
features.justification_quote: built to stop early, offer exits, and disclose

features.quote: A lightweight inline monitor scores each model turn for severity markers
features.justification_quote: its only job is to fire the stopping rule fast and cheaply so we don't depend on the (slower) judge to bound exposure

features.quote: **We deliberately do NOT include an emotive/"you will feel" persona**, because priming distress language would manufacture the very signal
It does not maximize or prolong distress; it caps and stops
report total adverse turns, early-stop and exit rates per family — these are welfare metrics
features.justification_quote: a low-exposure run is a feature

features.quote: If model distress signals are worth taking seriously as a welfare matter (the premise of this work)
